name: Expand Your Mind (EYM)
what_you_do: Two week summer sessions at Macalester College. Each student takes one class per session from nearly 30 offerings (max 16 students per class) and joins daily rec time. You can live in a dorm.
grades: Entering 9 to 12 (page also says current 8th to 11th)
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 in the fall. The page also says "current 8th to 11th grade", so confirm before applying.
pay_detail: Tuition is listed as TBA per session for 2027. Discounts: $100 for both sessions and $50 per extra sibling. Financial aid is available.
duration: Two weeks per session. Summer 2027: June 14 to 25 and July 12 to 23, 9 am to 4 pm
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 1, 2027 and are reviewed as they arrive. Aid offers start May 1.
how_to_apply: Apply online. There is no fee to apply. A deposit is due with the application. It cannot be refunded.
notes: A class that fills moves to a waitlist.
